settings.title: Settings
settings.commissionsNote: Any commission can be added with a configuration, no new code.
settings.aboutBody: Built by a Pleasanton student. Not an official City of Pleasanton or Youth Commission app. This app helps you prepare public comments; you deliver them yourself at public meetings.
settings.aiDisclosure: AI is used to understand your words, draft, and translate. Routing rules are written by the developer.
settings.languageHint: Pick any language. Comments are drafted in your language and in English.

reasons.preselected: {{body}} has this item on an upcoming agenda, so they can take it up.
reasons.federal: This belongs at the federal level, so the better contact is the office of Rep. Aisha Wahab (CA-14).
reasons.private: This looks like a private matter, not something a city body can decide.
reasons.schoolSite: A single school's rule is handled by that school's principal, not by a city commission.
reasons.ownsBpt: Crosswalks and walking routes are handled by the city, not the school district, so this goes to Bike, Pedestrian & Trails.
reasons.ownsYouth: Youth programs and teen spaces are the Youth Commission's topic, so this goes there.
reasons.ownsParks: Parks and recreation facilities are handled by the Parks & Recreation Commission.
reasons.ownsPusd: District-wide school policy is handled by the PUSD Board of Education, not the city.
reasons.item: This relates to Item {{number}} on their next agenda.
reasons.noItem: Nothing matching is on a posted agenda yet, so this is general public comment. They may add it to a future agenda.
reasons.fallback: No commission clearly owns this topic, so it goes to City Council as general public comment. They can hear it, but generally can't act on it that night. They may add it to a future agenda.
reasons.keepCouncil: You asked to keep a local comment. This will be City Council general public comment. They can hear it, but generally can't act on it that night.
reasons.keepOther: You asked to keep a comment for {{body}} as general public comment.
reasons.ownsLibrary: Library hours, programs, and services are handled by the Library Commission.

contact.federalDetail: This is a federal issue. The city can't pass it. The office of Rep. Aisha Wahab (CA-14) is the federal contact for this district.
contact.principalDetail: A rule that applies to one school site is handled at that school, not by the city. You can still give a general comment to the PUSD Board.
contact.privateName: This is a private matter, not a government one.
contact.privateDetail: City commissions can't settle a private dispute or a private business decision. You can still speak during general public comment if you want the city to hear a related public concern.
